summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a September 14, 2026 news release announcing its inclusion in the MVIS Global Junior Gold Miners Index (MVGDXJ), the benchmark for the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ), effective at the close of trading September 18, 2026, following the index's semi-annual review. No price, stake, premium or transaction terms were disclosed. Management cites improved institutional visibility and liquidity. This is an index-inclusion disclosure, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor or deal mechanics apply. Watch passive index-fund flows around the effective date.
